item.title: Sandesh Jhingan Slams Crores Spent on Messi’s GOAT Tour Amid ISL Crisis and Kolkata Riots in India
item.description: Indian captain Sandesh Jhingan questions crores poured into Lionel Messi's frenzied tour while domestic football faces shutdown amid investment woes and fan chaos.

item.title: Bangladesh Protest Updates: Daily Star Building Set on Fire, 25 Journalists Rescued, Awami League Offices Vandalised
item.description: Violent unrest grips Bangladesh as supporters of youth leader Sharif Osman Hadi target media houses and heritage.

item.title: Uttarakhand Clears 6,822 Trees in Bhagirathi Eco-Zone for Char Dham Road, Igniting Landslide Fears After Dharali Floods
item.description: Uttarakhand okays felling 6,822 trees in fragile Bhagirathi eco-zone for Char Dham widening, sparking outrage over hypocrisy and post-flood landslide risks.

item.title: Magadi Gang-Rape: 19-Year-Old Blackmailed with Videos by Boyfriend, Two Friends; All Arrested After Leak
item.description: 19-year-old student blackmailed with videos, gang-raped by boyfriend and pals in Magadi; arrested after leak.

item.title: WB Ambassador of Humanity Awards 2025 Honour Changemakers Driving Grassroots Social Change Across India
item.description: Held on World Human Rights Day, the WB Ambassador of Humanity Awards 2025 celebrated individuals whose compassion-led initiatives are transforming communities through education, inclusion, healthcare, and climate action.

item.title: Bangladesh: India Reopens Dhaka Visa Centre a Day After Anti-India Protest Shutdown
item.description: India resumes visa services in Dhaka a day after anti-India protests forced a shutdown, spotlighting fragile ties and human costs amid Bangladesh's political shifts.

item.title: ‘Worst Is Behind Us’: IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers Addresses Employees as Airline Restores Normal Operations
item.description: IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers released a video message on Thursday, 18 December 2025, to announce that the airline has successfully restored its network to 2,200 daily flights. This follows nearly two weeks of severe operational turmoil that saw thousands of cancellations across India. Elbers declared that the worst of the crisis is now behind them […]

item.title: Indian Railways Rolls Out Free Wi-Fi at Over 6,100 Stations, Expands CCTV Surveillance Nationwide
item.description: Indian Railways has connected 6,117 stations-93% of its network-with free high-speed Wi-Fi through revenue-sharing partnerships, saving over ₹1,200 crore in public funds.

item.title: IRS Rohit Mehra’s Free School of Trees: Delhi Kids Swap Brand Names for Neem, Peepal in Garden Immersion
item.description: IRS officer Rohit Mehra's free School of Trees in Delhi-NCR teaches urban kids nature hands-on, beating brand obsession.

item.title: Indian Army Colonel Duped in Fake Traffic Challan Scam, Loses Rs 3.81 Lakh to Cyber Fraud in Pune
item.description: An Army officer lost Rs 3.81 lakh after clicking a fake traffic fine payment link.
